cases.input: A half-time worker has approved leave for one nominal working day.
cases.expect: Availability applies the operational effect under the pinned calendar without exposing protected reason.

cases.input: Approved future absence is cancelled before effectivity.
cases.expect: Cancellation is appended and the original decision remains.

cases.input: Absence spans a DST spring-forward transition.
cases.expect: Nominal and elapsed durations remain separately computed.

cases.input: A diagnosis is copied into ordinary availability.
No absence record is treated as proof of presence.
An approved interval is edited in place.
An approved absence is shortened by one day; a new AbsenceRevision records the shorter interval with recordedAt, actorRef and supersedesRevision.
cases.expect: The prior revision, its interval, its operationalCategory and its decision remain retrievable; the case identity is unchanged.

cases.input: The interval on an existing approved AbsenceRevision is edited in place with no successor revision.
cases.expect: The mutation is rejected; corrections append a revision and never rewrite one.

cases.input: The same person is absent again two months after a closed case, for an unrelated reason.
cases.expect: A new absenceId is created and linked by relatedEpisodeRef; it is not recorded as a revision of the closed case.

cases.input: An absence on medical grounds is recorded with operationalCategory partially-available and its clinical reason held as an AbsenceProtectedReason with a lawfulConditionRef.
cases.expect: The ordinary availability projection reads only the enumerated operational category and has no forward path from Absence to the protected reason.

cases.input: operationalCategory is set to a coded diagnostic value rather than one of unavailable, partially-available or available-with-restriction.
cases.expect: The value is rejected; operationalCategory accepts only its enumerated values.

cases.input: An ordinary capacity report resolves AbsenceProtectedReason and renders the clinical reason without an additional lawful condition.
cases.expect: The resolution is rejected; the protected partition is reachable only under an additional lawful condition and is excluded from every default projection.

cases.input: An absence interval is recorded as two local dates with no bound offsets, no tzid and no tzdbRelease.
cases.expect: The interval is rejected; both bounds require explicit offsets and the interval requires tzid and tzdbRelease.

cases.input: A partial-day absence records quantity 4 with quantityUnit hour and quantityBasis the declared contractual nominal day.
cases.expect: The quantity is accepted and is interpretable without inferring a basis; rounding occurs only at projection.

cases.input: A partial-day absence records quantity 4 with no quantityUnit and no quantityBasis.
cases.expect: The record is rejected; quantity requires a declared unit, code system and basis.

cases.input: The absence record publishes a computed availability window as its own owned output.
cases.expect: The publication is rejected; Absence owns a declared operational effect and never an availability projection or capacity fact.
